# STX Downloader

> A Windows app that saves media you're allowed to keep, from YouTube and from web pages, tells you what the audio really is, and plays your whole collection with VLC's engine. Open source under the MIT license, published by Strategia-X.

One Windows app for three jobs: save, check and play. DRM-protected media is out of scope: STX doesn't save or play it, and you're responsible for each site's terms and the law where you live.

## Pages

- [Project page](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/): what STX does, its screens, whether it's safe, the download, and what has been tested
- [Screens](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/#screens): the Library, Settings, the user guide and the tutorials, captured from the app
- [Download](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/#download): the signed setup and the portable zip, with their SHA-256 hashes
- [Full reference](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/llms-full.txt): all of it in plain text
- [Release history](https://git-rocky-stack.github.io/STX-Downloader/long-llms.txt): the notes of each release, newest first, made from the changelog
